artifact: B2b scATAC fragments->cell x peak matrix bridge real-data validation
summary: Validation of the new fragments->matrix bridge (aria/scripts/chromatin_fragments_to_matrix.py) that lets raw single-cell ATAC fragments reach the full validated matrix pipeline (LSI -> DA -> motif -> regulatory). Ran end-to-end on real 10x PBMC Multiome fragments: snapatac2 de-novo path (import_fragments -> tile matrix -> spectral -> leiden preliminary groups -> MACS3 per group -> merge_peaks -> make_peak_matrix) produced a cell x peak matrix, and the downstream LSI clustering script consumed it and clustered the cells. This closes the C4 gap (raw scATAC previously stopped at QC + MACS3 + motifs).

validates: chromatin_fragments_to_matrix builds a real cell x peak AnnData from a real fragments file (de-novo snapatac2 path)
the produced .h5ad is consumed by the validated LSI clustering script (chromatin_lsi_clustering) which clusters the cells
the full raw-fragments -> matrix -> LSI chain runs on real single-cell data
does_not_validate: this is a plumbing/end-to-end check, not a biological-accuracy benchmark of clustering or peak calling (scATAC clustering/motif concordance is validated separately in P3a/P3b)
run was restricted to chr20 of the PBMC fragments for tractability (a real-genome subset, not whole genome)
the 'provided' peak mode (reuse externally-called peaks) shares the same make_peak_matrix call but was not separately benchmarked here

input.dataset: Real 10x PBMC Multiome ATAC fragments (memory/datasets/scatac/pbmc_multiome_fragments.tsv.gz), chr20 subset via tabix

wiring: ChromatinAgent._run_scatac now attempts the bridge after QC + MACS3 on raw fragments (reusing the MACS3 peaks as the peak set when available, 'provided' mode); on success it dispatches the full matrix pipeline via _run_scatac_matrix (reusing the fragments-side QC, no recompute). On failure it falls back to the honest QC + peaks (+ motif) C4 path with the bridge's skip reason.

provenance.determinism_note: snapatac2 spectral/leiden have stochastic components; the preliminary clustering only groups cells for MACS3 and is re-clustered downstream by the validated LSI pipeline, so the final matrix peak set is stable up to MACS3's group definitions.
